title: 🌙 पारो का खरगोश दीवार पर अंगूठे जितना ही रह गया... अब बड़ा कैसे? #kahani #bedtimestories
title_alts: 🤔 क्या पारो का अंगूठे जितना खरगोश पूरी दीवार तक बड़ा हो पाएगा? #kahani #bedtimestories
😮 पारो लैंप को दीवार से सटाती है, और उसका खरगोश छोटा हो गया... #kahani #bedtimestories
description_hook: पारो के हाथ दीवार पर खरगोश बना लेते हैं, पर वह अंगूठे जितना ही रहता है। बड़ा और साफ़, दोनों एक साथ कैसे?

characters.name: पारो
characters.description: four years old, two short braids, yellow kurta, laces her hands into shadow animals

scenes.narration: आज पारो को दीवार पर खरगोश चाहिए, वरना नींद नहीं आती। वह बिस्तर पर घुटनों के बल बैठी है।
scenes.caption: Tonight Paro wants a rabbit on the wall, or sleep will not come.
scenes.image_brief: Paro, a four-year-old girl in a yellow kurta with two short braids, kneeling on a low wooden bed in a small bedroom, facing a bare cream wall, a small lamp glowing on a shelf behind her.

scenes.narration: रात हो चुकी है। कमरा शांत है। दीवार बिलकुल खाली है।
scenes.caption: Night has settled in. The room is quiet. The wall is completely bare.
scenes.image_brief: The whole bedroom seen from the open doorway: two low beds, a bare cream wall, a shelf lamp throwing a warm pool of light, one dark window.

scenes.narration: पारो अपने दोनों हाथ जोड़ती है। दो उँगलियाँ सीधी ऊपर उठाती है।
scenes.caption: Paro brings both hands together and lifts two fingers straight up.
scenes.image_brief: Only Paro's two small hands, fingers laced together with two fingers raised, held up in warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: ये खरगोश के कान हैं। लैंप की रोशनी सीधे उन पर पड़ती है।
scenes.caption: These are rabbit ears. The lamp light falls right on them.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's hands from behind her shoulder, two raised fingers standing like ears against the lit wall ahead of her.

scenes.narration: पारो की दीवार पर एक नन्ही छाया उभरती है। बस अंगूठे जितनी बड़ी।
scenes.caption: A tiny shadow appears on Paro's wall. Only as big as her thumb.
scenes.image_brief: The bare cream wall alone, with one thumb-sized rabbit shadow near its middle, warm light washing the rest of the plaster.

scenes.narration: पारो दो बार ताली बजाती है और कहती है, दो ताली, एक खरगोश!
scenes.caption: Paro claps twice and says, two claps, one rabbit!
scenes.image_brief: Paro's face and open palms mid-clap, her mouth shaped in speech, lamp light on one cheek, the dark room behind her.

scenes.narration: छाया हिलती है। कान फड़फड़ाते हैं। पारो धीरे से हँसती है।
scenes.caption: The shadow moves. The ears flap. Paro laughs softly.
scenes.image_brief: The small rabbit shadow on the wall with its ears tipped sideways, and Paro's hands at the very edge of the frame.

scenes.narration: पर यह खरगोश बहुत छोटा है। पारो को बड़ा चाहिए।
scenes.caption: But this rabbit is far too small. Paro wants a big one.
scenes.image_brief: Paro sitting back on her heels on the bed, shoulders dropped, staring at the wall where the tiny shadow sits.

scenes.narration: पारो को दरवाज़े जितना बड़ा खरगोश चाहिए। कान छत तक पहुँचें।
scenes.caption: Paro wants a rabbit as big as the door. Ears that reach the ceiling.
scenes.image_brief: The tall closed bedroom door, with Paro standing beside it and stretching one hand up toward the ceiling to measure it.

scenes.narration: पारो ने दीदी से छोटा लैंप माँगा। दीदी ने तुरंत दे दिया।
scenes.caption: Paro asked her big sister for the small lamp. She handed it over at once.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's older sister standing by the bed holding out a small clip-on lamp, Paro's hands rising to take it, warm light between them.

scenes.narration: अब लैंप तकिए के पास है। रोशनी पारो के हाथ में है।
scenes.caption: Now the lamp sits by the pillow. The light is in Paro's hands.
scenes.image_brief: The small lamp resting on the mattress beside a flat pillow, its light spilling across the sheet and over Paro's fingers.

scenes.narration: फिर भी पारो का खरगोश उतना ही छोटा है। अंगूठे जितना।
scenes.caption: Still Paro's rabbit stays just as small. Thumb sized.
scenes.image_brief: The cream wall with the same thumb-sized rabbit shadow on it, and the lamp now glowing close by on the bed below.

scenes.narration: पारो पूछती है, क्या तुम भी मेरे साथ बोलोगे? दो ताली बजाओ।
scenes.caption: Paro asks, will you say it with me? Clap twice.
scenes.image_brief: Paro clapping with her hands wide apart, the bedcover rumpled around her knees, lamp light coming low from one side.

scenes.narration: पारो सोचती है, लैंप को दीवार के पास ले जाऊँ।
scenes.caption: Paro thinks, let me carry the lamp closer to the wall.
scenes.image_brief: Paro on hands and knees at the edge of the bed, both hands gripping the lamp's base, her eyes on the wall.

scenes.narration: पारो लैंप को घसीटकर दीवार से सटा देती है।
scenes.caption: Paro drags the lamp until it touches the wall.
scenes.image_brief: The lamp pushed right up against the cream wall, its paper shade almost touching the plaster, Paro's hand still on it.

scenes.narration: पारो की छाया और छोटी हो गई। मटर के दाने जितनी।
scenes.caption: Paro's shadow got even smaller. No bigger than a pea.
scenes.image_brief: The cream wall with a pea-sized rabbit shadow on it, the lamp glowing right at the wall's base below.

scenes.narration: पारो चौंक जाती है। यह तो उलटा हो गया।
scenes.caption: Paro is startled. That went the wrong way.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's face with her eyebrows lifted in surprise, lit from below by the lamp lying on the bedsheet.

scenes.narration: लैंप दीवार के पास आया, तो हाथ लैंप से दूर हो गए।
scenes.caption: The lamp came near the wall, so her hands ended up far from the lamp.
scenes.image_brief: The bedroom from the side: the lamp pressed to the wall on the left, Paro's raised hands far away near her pillow on the right.

scenes.narration: हाथ रोशनी से जितने दूर, छाया उतनी ही छोटी बनती है।
scenes.caption: The farther the hands are from the light, the smaller the shadow gets.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's hands making ears while held well away from the small lamp, a little shadow on the wall beyond them.

scenes.narration: यही सबसे आम गलती है। लैंप को दीवार से चिपकाना।
scenes.caption: This is the commonest mistake. Sticking the lamp against the wall.
scenes.image_brief: The lamp's paper shade squashed flat against the plaster, a narrow band of light creeping along the wall.

scenes.narration: पारो लैंप उठाकर पीछे, दरवाज़े के पास रख देती है।
scenes.caption: Paro picks the lamp up and sets it back near the door.
scenes.image_brief: Paro walking barefoot across the floor holding the lamp toward the closed bedroom door, its wire trailing behind her.

scenes.narration: करीब चार कदम पीछे। यह गिनती अंदाज़े की है।
scenes.caption: About four steps back. That count is only a rough one.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's bare feet on the floor mid-step beside the stretched lamp wire, warm light from behind her ankles.

scenes.narration: छाया बड़ी हो गई, पर बहुत फीकी। कान दिखते ही नहीं।
scenes.caption: The shadow grew bigger, but very faint. The ears do not show at all.
scenes.image_brief: The wall carrying one large pale rabbit shape with no clear ears, the plaster barely darker where the shadow lies.

scenes.narration: दूर से रोशनी कमज़ोर पहुँचती है। पारो की दीवार धुँधली सी लगती है।
scenes.caption: From far away the light arrives weak. Paro's wall looks hazy.
scenes.image_brief: The whole bedroom in weak light, the lamp small in the far door corner, both low beds dim.

scenes.narration: पारो लैंप वापस तकिए पर लाती है। हाथ रोशनी से सटा देती है।
scenes.caption: Paro brings the lamp back to the pillow and puts her hands right against the light.
scenes.image_brief: Paro back on the bed with the lamp beside her pillow, her laced hands held so close that the glow spills around her fingers.

scenes.narration: अब पारो का खरगोश दरवाज़े जितना बड़ा है! पूरी दीवार भर गई।
scenes.caption: Now Paro's rabbit is as big as the door! The whole wall is filled.
scenes.image_brief: A huge rabbit shadow covering the cream wall from floor to ceiling, Paro tiny on the bed in front of it.

scenes.narration: पर कान गायब हैं। छाया धुँधले बादल जैसी है।
scenes.caption: But the ears have vanished. The shadow is like a blurred cloud.
scenes.image_brief: A big soft grey blob of shadow spread over the wall with no ear shapes anywhere in it.

scenes.narration: किनारे कहीं ख़त्म ही नहीं होते। छाया धुएँ की तरह फैलती है।
scenes.caption: The edges never end anywhere. The shadow spreads out like smoke.
scenes.image_brief: The corner where the wall meets the ceiling, the shadow's edge fading away into the lit plaster.

scenes.narration: पारो बिस्तर पर खड़ी होती है और हाथ ऊपर उठाती है।
scenes.caption: Paro stands up on the bed and lifts her hands high.
scenes.image_brief: Paro standing on the soft mattress with both arms raised above her head, the lamp glowing near her ankles.

scenes.narration: पारो के सिर की छाया पूरे खरगोश को निगल जाती है।
scenes.caption: The shadow of Paro's own head swallows the whole rabbit.
scenes.image_brief: A large dark shadow of Paro's head and shoulders covering the wall, only a sliver of the rabbit shape left at its side.

scenes.narration: पारो घुटनों पर बैठ जाती है। सिर की छाया नीचे उतर जाती है।
scenes.caption: Paro drops onto her knees. The shadow of her head slides down.
scenes.image_brief: Paro kneeling low on the bed with her arms raised above her, her head below the lamp's light line, the wall ahead brightly washed.

scenes.narration: पारो का खरगोश लौट आया। बड़ा, मगर फिर भी धुँधला।
scenes.caption: Paro's rabbit came back. Big, but still blurred.
scenes.image_brief: The wall holding a large soft-edged rabbit shadow whose ears can only just be guessed at.

scenes.narration: पारो हथेली से लैंप को घेरती है। रोशनी उँगलियों से छनकर निकलती है।
scenes.caption: Paro cups a palm around the lamp. The light leaks out between her fingers.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's cupped palm curved around the glowing lamp, bright light slipping through the gaps between her fingers.

scenes.narration: पारो का एक हाथ लैंप पर लगा, तो कान बनाने के लिए हाथ ही नहीं बचे।
scenes.caption: With one of Paro's hands on the lamp, no hands are left for the ears.
scenes.image_brief: One of Paro's hands resting on the lamp while the other waves alone in the air, an unfinished shape on the wall beyond.

scenes.narration: देर तक हाथ ऊपर रखने से पारो के हाथ दुखने लगे।
scenes.caption: From holding them up so long, Paro's arms began to ache.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's arms lowered into her lap, the lamp glowing beside her knee, the cream wall in front of her empty.

scenes.narration: बड़ा या साफ़, दोनों एक साथ नहीं। यही पहेली है।
scenes.caption: Big or sharp, never both at once. That is the puzzle.
scenes.image_brief: Paro sitting cross-legged facing the bare wall with her chin propped on a fist, lamp light coming from her side.

scenes.narration: उसी पल दूसरे बिस्तर पर छोटी बहन जाग जाती है।
scenes.caption: At that moment her little sister wakes up on the other bed.
scenes.image_brief: The second low bed across the room, a younger girl with tousled hair sitting up under a thin blanket, dim light on her face.

scenes.narration: छोटी बहन उठकर बैठ जाती है। उसे भी खरगोश चाहिए।
scenes.caption: The little sister sits up. She wants a rabbit too.
scenes.image_brief: The younger sister rubbing one eye and turning toward Paro's lit wall, her own wall dark behind her head.

scenes.narration: छोटी बोली, खरगोश मेरी दीवार पर भी चाहिए।
scenes.caption: The little one said, I want a rabbit on my wall as well.
scenes.image_brief: The younger sister pointing up at the bare wall above her own bed, the lamp's light reaching only halfway across the floor.

scenes.narration: अब दो बहनें हैं, दो दीवारें हैं, और लैंप सिर्फ़ एक।
scenes.caption: Now there are two sisters, two walls, and only one lamp.
scenes.image_brief: Both low beds in one frame with a bare wall behind each, and the single small lamp on the floor between them.

scenes.narration: पारो लैंप छोटी की तरफ़ घुमाती है। बारी बारी, यही तय होता है।
scenes.caption: Paro turns the lamp toward her sister. Turn by turn, that is the deal.
scenes.image_brief: Paro leaning over to swivel the lamp's head toward her sister's side of the room, both girls watching the light move.

scenes.narration: पर तार छोटा है। करीब चार कदम, उससे आगे नहीं।
scenes.caption: But the wire is short. About four steps, and no further.
scenes.image_brief: The lamp's wire pulled straight and taut across the floor to a low socket, with no slack left in it.

scenes.narration: लैंप एक ही दीवार तक पहुँचता है। दोनों तक नहीं।
scenes.caption: The lamp reaches one wall only. Not both of them.
scenes.image_brief: The lamp sitting at the far end of its stretched wire, its glow landing on one wall while the opposite wall stays dark.

scenes.narration: छोटी की दीवार पर खरगोश आया। पारो की दीवार अँधेरी हो गई।
scenes.caption: A rabbit arrived on the little one's wall. Paro's wall went dark.
scenes.image_brief: The sister's wall carrying a rabbit shadow while Paro's wall on the other side of the room lies in darkness.

scenes.narration: पारो ने ताली बजाकर कहा, दो ताली, एक खरगोश! दीवार अँधेरी ही रही।
scenes.caption: Paro clapped and said, two claps, one rabbit! Her wall stayed dark.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's hands caught mid-clap in the unlit half of the room, her blank wall behind them in shadow.

scenes.narration: पारो को दोनों दीवारें एक साथ चाहिए। बीच में लैंप रखना है।
scenes.caption: Paro wants both walls at once. The lamp must stand in the middle.
scenes.image_brief: Paro on the floor between the two beds with her arms spread toward both bare walls, the lamp glowing near her feet.

scenes.narration: पारो तार को दोनों हाथों से खींचती है।
scenes.caption: Paro pulls at the wire with both hands.
scenes.image_brief: Both of Paro's hands gripping the lamp's wire and hauling on it, her knuckles pale with the effort.

scenes.narration: तार में ढील नहीं बची। वह पूरा तन गया।
scenes.caption: No slack was left in the wire. It went completely tight.
scenes.image_brief: The wire lifted off the floorboards in one straight taut line running back to a low wall socket.

scenes.narration: लैंप तकिए के किनारे पर डोला, फिर फ़र्श पर गिर पड़ा।
scenes.caption: The lamp wobbled on the pillow's edge, then fell to the floor.
scenes.image_brief: The small lamp tipping off the edge of the pillow and dropping toward the wooden floor, light swinging wildly.

scenes.narration: काग़ज़ का शेड खिसककर उतर गया। बल्ब अब नंगा है।
scenes.caption: The paper shade slipped right off. The bulb is bare now.
scenes.image_brief: The loose paper shade lying on the floorboards beside a small bare bulb burning brightly on its stand.

scenes.narration: रोशनी अब हर तरफ़ फैल रही है। छत पर भी।
scenes.caption: The light spreads in every direction now. Onto the ceiling too.
scenes.image_brief: The ceiling and the tops of both walls flooded with harsh even light, the bare bulb small and glaring below.

scenes.narration: दोनों दीवारें दूध जैसी सफ़ेद पड़ गईं।
scenes.caption: Both walls turned milk white.
scenes.image_brief: Both bedroom walls washed flat and milky with light, not one shadow anywhere on them.

scenes.narration: पारो के हाथ हिले, पर कोई छाया नहीं बनी। न कान, न कोई किनारा।
scenes.caption: Paro's hands moved, but no shadow formed. No ears, no edge.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's hands shaping ears in front of the bare bulb while the wall behind them shows nothing at all.

scenes.narration: पहले एक खरगोश था। अब एक भी नहीं।
scenes.caption: Before there was one rabbit. Now there is not even one.
scenes.image_brief: Both girls' walls in a single frame, both of them blank and overbright, the beds untidy below.

scenes.narration: छोटी ने कंबल सिर तक खींच लिया। वह चुप हो गई।
scenes.caption: The little one pulled her blanket over her head. She went quiet.
scenes.image_brief: The younger sister on her bed with the thin blanket dragged up over her head, only her hair showing.

scenes.narration: कमरा सपाट और उजला है। कहीं कुछ नहीं हिलता।
scenes.caption: The room is flat and glaring. Nothing moves anywhere.
scenes.image_brief: The whole bedroom lit evenly and harshly from the floor, every corner pale, nothing in motion.

scenes.narration: पारो फ़र्श पर बैठी है, हाथ में काग़ज़ का शेड।
scenes.caption: Paro sits on the floor with the paper shade in her hand.
scenes.image_brief: Paro sitting cross-legged on the floorboards with the crumpled paper shade resting in her lap.

scenes.narration: सवाल बड़ा या साफ़ का नहीं रहा। अब कुछ भी नहीं है।
scenes.caption: It is no longer a question of big or sharp. Now there is nothing.
scenes.image_brief: The bent paper shade held between Paro's fingers, its creased edges catching the bulb's light.

scenes.narration: एक लैंप। दो दीवारें। और चारों तरफ़ बिखरी रोशनी।
scenes.caption: One lamp. Two walls. And light scattered all around.
scenes.image_brief: The bare bulb standing on the floorboards with its wire coiled beside it, light spraying out across the room.

scenes.narration: पारो ने काग़ज़ को उँगलियों में घुमाया और एक पतली नली बना दी।
scenes.caption: Paro rolled the paper in her fingers and made a narrow tube.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's fingers curling the paper shade around into a narrow tube, her thumbs holding the seam shut.

scenes.narration: शेड कोई छाया नहीं बना सका था। नली शायद बना दे।
scenes.caption: The shade could not make any shadow. A tube just might.
scenes.image_brief: Paro holding the rolled paper tube up beside the bare glowing bulb, comparing the two in her hands.

scenes.narration: पारो ने नली को बल्ब के ऊपर खड़ा कर दिया।
scenes.caption: Paro stood the tube up over the bulb.
scenes.image_brief: The paper tube standing upright over the small bulb like a chimney, its open end pointed at the cream wall, the rest of the room dark again.

scenes.narration: रोशनी अब एक ही पतली धार में निकलती है।
scenes.caption: Now the light comes out in one thin stream.
scenes.image_brief: A single narrow shaft of light crossing the dark bedroom from the paper tube to the far wall.

scenes.narration: यह धार दीवार पर एक गोल चकती बनाती है।
scenes.caption: That stream makes one round patch on the wall.
scenes.image_brief: One bright round disc of light sitting on the cream wall with everything around it dim.

scenes.narration: पारो अपने हाथ उस धार के सामने ले जाती है।
scenes.caption: Paro brings her hands in front of that stream.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's laced hands moving into the narrow beam of light just above the paper tube.

scenes.narration: किनारे साफ़ हैं! कान नुकीले और अलग अलग दिखते हैं।
scenes.caption: The edges are sharp! The ears look pointed and separate.
scenes.image_brief: The wall holding a crisp-edged rabbit shadow with two pointed ears standing clearly apart from each other.

scenes.narration: छोटी कंबल से बाहर आती है। खरगोश फिर बन गया।
scenes.caption: The little one comes out of the blanket. The rabbit is back.
scenes.image_brief: The younger sister pushing the blanket down off her face and looking across the room, light on one cheek.

scenes.narration: पर खरगोश अब भी एक ही दीवार पर है।
scenes.caption: But the rabbit is still on one wall only.
scenes.image_brief: The sister's wall lying in darkness while Paro's wall opposite carries the sharp rabbit shadow.

scenes.narration: पारो पानी की ट्रे से स्टील की थाली उठाती है।
scenes.caption: Paro lifts the steel plate off the water tray.
scenes.image_brief: Paro lifting a round steel plate from a tray that holds a water jug and two small tumblers, beside her bed.

scenes.narration: पारो थाली को छोटी के बिस्तर के पास दीवार से टिका देती है।
scenes.caption: Paro props the plate against the wall near her sister's bed.
scenes.image_brief: Paro standing the steel plate upright against the wall beside her sister's bed, holding its rim steady.

scenes.narration: फिर पारो थाली को ज़रा ज़रा तिरछा करती है।
scenes.caption: Then Paro tilts the plate a little at a time.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's fingers tipping the steel plate at a slant, the bright beam sliding across its shining surface.

scenes.narration: धार थाली से टकराई और छोटी की दीवार पर जा गिरी।
scenes.caption: The stream hit the plate and landed on the little one's wall.
scenes.image_brief: The beam striking the tilted steel plate and bouncing back across the room onto the sister's wall.

scenes.narration: अब दो दीवारों पर रोशनी है। हाथ सिर्फ़ एक जोड़ी।
scenes.caption: Now there is light on two walls. Only one pair of hands.
scenes.image_brief: Both bedroom walls in one frame, each carrying a patch of light, the single paper-tube lamp glowing on the floor between them.

scenes.narration: पारो कहती है, अब मेरे साथ उँगलियों से दो कान बनाओ।
scenes.caption: Paro says, now make two ears with your fingers along with me.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's hands with two fingers raised as ears, the beam passing over them toward the lit wall beyond.

scenes.narration: दो दीवार, दो खरगोश, एक लैंप। पारो ज़ोर से गिनती है।
scenes.caption: Two walls, two rabbits, one lamp. Paro counts it out loud.
scenes.image_brief: Paro sitting upright on the floor counting on her fingers, a lit wall behind her on each side.

scenes.narration: दोनों दीवारों पर खरगोश बैठे हैं। दरवाज़े जितने बड़े।
scenes.caption: A rabbit sits on each of the two walls. As big as the door.
scenes.image_brief: Both bedroom walls carrying a large rabbit shadow, the space between them dark, the paper-tube lamp low on the floor.

scenes.narration: कान छत तक पहुँच रहे हैं। किनारे बिलकुल साफ़ हैं।
scenes.caption: The ears are reaching the ceiling. The edges are perfectly sharp.
scenes.image_brief: Two tall shadow ears rising up one wall to the line where it meets the ceiling, their edges crisp.

scenes.narration: छोटी खिलखिलाकर हँसती है और बिस्तर पर बैठ जाती है।
scenes.caption: The little one bursts into giggles and sits up in bed.
scenes.image_brief: The younger sister sitting up laughing with her hands on the blanket, her own lit wall behind her.

scenes.narration: पारो उँगली मोड़ती है। दोनों खरगोश साथ में कान हिलाते हैं।
scenes.caption: Paro bends a finger. Both rabbits flick their ears together.
scenes.image_brief: One of Paro's fingers bent over in the beam, and the folded ear shape repeated on the wall behind.

scenes.narration: पारो थाली घुमाती है। खरगोश एक दीवार से दूसरी पर कूद जाता है।
scenes.caption: Paro turns the plate. The rabbit jumps from one wall to the other.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's hand swivelling the steel plate while a bright streak sweeps across the room from one wall to the other.

scenes.narration: छोटी हर कूद पर ताली बजाती है। कमरा हँसी से भर गया।
scenes.caption: The little one claps at every jump. The room filled with laughter.
scenes.image_brief: The younger sister clapping on her bed with her mouth open in a laugh, shadow ears above her.

scenes.narration: अब खरगोश छोटी के तकिए के ठीक ऊपर बैठा है।
scenes.caption: Now the rabbit sits right above the little one's pillow.
scenes.image_brief: A rabbit shadow resting on the wall directly over the younger sister's pillow, her head settling below it.

scenes.narration: पारो थाली को वहीं थाम लेती है। हिलने नहीं देती।
scenes.caption: Paro holds the plate right there. She lets it move no further.
scenes.image_brief: Paro's fingers gripping the rim of the steel plate to hold it still against the wall.

scenes.narration: पारो और छोटी ने एक साथ कहा, दो ताली, एक खरगोश!
scenes.caption: Paro and her little sister said it together, two claps, one rabbit!
scenes.image_brief: Both girls with their palms pressed together mid-clap, facing each other across the dark room, shadows on both walls.

scenes.narration: अब एक खरगोश दो दीवारों का है।
scenes.caption: Now one rabbit belongs to two walls.
scenes.image_brief: One frame holding both walls, the same rabbit shape on each, the paper-tube lamp glowing between them.

scenes.narration: छोटी की पलकें झपकने लगीं। खरगोश उसके तकिए पर बैठा रहा।
scenes.caption: The little one's eyelids began to droop. The rabbit stayed over her pillow.
scenes.image_brief: The younger sister's eyes closing on her pillow, the rabbit shadow steady on the wall above her hair.

scenes.narration: पारो को यही सबसे अच्छा लगा। कमरा भरा भरा लगता है।
scenes.caption: This was what Paro liked best. The room feels full now.
scenes.image_brief: Paro sitting on the floor turning her head to take in the dark room with a shadow rabbit on either side.

scenes.narration: पारो मुस्कुराती है। उसकी दीवार भी अब खाली नहीं है।
scenes.caption: Paro smiles. Her own wall is not empty any more.
scenes.image_brief: Paro smiling with the rabbit shadow on her own wall rising just behind her shoulder.

scenes.narration: पारो कंबल में सरक गई। दोनों दीवारों पर कान अब भी खड़े हैं।
scenes.caption: Paro slid under her blanket. The ears still stand on both walls.
scenes.image_brief: Paro tucked under her blanket on her low bed, shadow ears standing tall on the wall at each side of the room.

scenes.narration: पारो ने आँखें मूँदीं और धीरे से कहा, दो ताली, एक खरगोश!
scenes.caption: Paro closed her eyes and said softly, two claps, one rabbit!
scenes.image_brief: Paro's face with closed eyes resting on her pillow, a faint rabbit shadow on the wall above her head.
